explanation: The war that opened at Chai in September 1964 is what made FRELIMO the government of Mozambique. It fought the Portuguese state for ten years; it was recognised at Lusaka in 1974 as the only party Lisbon would negotiate the transfer with, without a ballot being held to establish that; and it took the state whole at independence in June 1975. The election of 1977 is that state asking to be confirmed by a single list. The monopoly on the paper is the war's monopoly on the nationalist movement carried into government — which is also why the atlas can wire this ballot at all, where it retracted the colonial elections of the same country before 1974.
